scope: Synthetic, in-process Customer Portal Sandbox only
limitations: Runtime dependencies and omitted scaffold configuration are supplemental current-sandbox evidence, separately hashed; they are not retrospectively part of the frozen candidate.
No network listener, production, TLS, shared-worker throttling, monitoring or tenant-isolation assurance.
Advisory lookup is a point-in-time known-vulnerability check, not proof of absence of dependency defects.
required_actions: Renewed review before application changes or real HTTP/deployment use
